t: Grinding the Lens: A Case Study in Reducing AI-Generated Code Sprawl
s: This article explores the challenge of managing AI-generated code complexity, using Pipulate as a case study. It argues for deliberate simplicity and dives into the ephemeral nature of LLMs, their 'little death' between prompts, and the implications for persistent AI systems.
sub: LLM ephemeral nature and context windows
Philosophical approach to AI development simplicity
The 'little death' of LLMs between prompts
